gap.description: Distance between dots in px. Lower is denser.

dotSize.description: Dot radius in px at rest.

radius.description: Lens radius around the pointer in px.

strength.description: How far dots are pushed at the strongest point of the lens, in px.

ripple.description: Clicks and taps send a ripple through the field.

fade.description: Fades the field toward its edges.

color.description: Dot color at rest. Defaults to the strong border token.

activeColor.description: Color dots take under the lens and in ripples. Defaults to the accent token.

children.description: Content drawn over the field, such as a hero headline.
